<thought>We need to determine the number of aromatic carbons in the molecule. The most direct way is to obtain the 13C NMR spectrum for the sample, which will show signals for aromatic carbons (typically in the 110‑160 ppm region). By counting those signals we can infer the number of aromatic carbons.</thought>
